text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With Mejiro Dober's debut race safely behind us,
we need to decide on our next goal.
Speaking of the typical royal road that Umamusume aim for—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The Classic Triple Crown route of the Satsuki Sho, the Tokyo Yushun (Japanese Derby), and the Kikuka Sho, huh—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The Triple Tiara route:
the Oka Sho, the Oaks, and the Shuka Sho."
choice_data_list: (First, I'd like to hear what Dober wants to do.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At that very same moment, under the evening sky,
two shadows were racing along—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Yaaahhhh~~~!!!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Kh... Haaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, I did it~!
Looks like I was first, wasn't I?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that was amazing...!
I was totally blown away...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
That's wonderful to hear♪ It seems our
training has borne at least some fruit, then~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Training... Come to think of it, Bright,
you changed your menu recently, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: They say you've been pushing yourself even harder than before... Ryan seemed pretty busy, torn between worrying about you and celebrating your growth.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: My♪ Fufufu, Ryan-oneesama, honestly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...However, it is not just me.
Ever since the Make Debut, you have changed as well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh... Y-You think so?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh, you're not aware of it yourself~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...I have watched her for a very, very long time,
so I can tell. Dober's eyes have changed.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Indeed, with the current you—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Hm? ...What is it, Bright?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Dober.
Could you spare a little time for me after this?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
*Haa*, what a lovely view~.
You can see so far into the distance, can't you~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...Bright.
What brings you all the way out here?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Hey, Dober.
Is the Mejiro estate over that way, I wonder~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"It brings back memories, doesn't it~?
The days I spent with you over there—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
When we were little, the two of us snuck into the study, didn't we?
If I remember correctly, Dober, you took me by the hand and led me around back then~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
That happened because Bright walked so leisurely,
even though we'd get scolded if we got caught.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for taking care of me back then~♪
...So, you got to see quite a lot of it, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Lined up on the shelves were countless proofs of glory...
The grand history woven by the Mejiro family."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Lady McQueen, Ryan-onesama, Lady Palmer... and so many other esteemed seniors carried on the glory of the Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Inherited, polished, and elevated...
Thanks to all of you, the Mejiro name
continues to shine brilliantly in the racing world today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Then what about us?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Will you remain the "youngest of the Mejiros" forever...? Sheltered under past glory, merely gazing in awe at those proud hoofprints~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I do not think so.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Bright...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Dober. I shall most certainly follow in your footsteps,
make a sensational debut, and—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Eventually, the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Even my beloved elder sister Ryan missed
that fierce glory, but I—
I will be the one to offer it to the Mejiro name, without fail.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"And without fail—it is I who will become
the 'New Glory of the Mejiro.'"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...!
A new glory...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yeees.
—So, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: What will you do~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(All this time... I thought I was the only one
left in the dark.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(Bright, Ryan, McQueen, and the others can walk toward the light on their own two feet...
I thought, "I've become different from them.")

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (Even so—!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I gave it... everything I had just now...!
Right here... in this race!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaaahhh!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(Thanks to everyone, I was able to run all the way to the end.
It gave me just a little bit of confidence
that even someone like me can do it...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (With this surge of excitement still lingering in my chest, I know I can...!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I... because...!
I'm gonna aim for the exact same thing Bright is!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm going after the Triple Tiara.
The Oka Sho, the Yushun Himba, the Shuka Sho...
I'll take all three races—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
The pride of the Mejiros... the first ever to claim the Triple Tiara.
I will follow in Ramonu-san's footsteps!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: That's why—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm not letting you go on ahead alone.
Let's paint this together, Bright.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Together, we shall bring about "a new glory for the Mejiro"...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Fufufu... I knew it♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I knew Dober as she is now
would say something like that~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Wait. Don't tell me you actually tried it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: No, no, tested you? Perish the thought~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"I simply wanted to hear your feelings
expressed in your own words."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Haaah... I really can't beat you when it comes to that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Now then~, once again—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Would you take my hand, Dober?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: —Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Dober & Bright
text_block_list.text:
Both the Triple Crown and the Triple Tiara.
Together, the two of us will bring new glory to the Mejiro name—!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Their vows rang out loud and clear toward the setting sun—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That night, Mejiro Dober
came to confide everything to me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That alongside her classmate Mejiro Bright, she wants to weave "a new glory for the Mejiro name."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And that for that reason,
she wants to aim for the Triple Tiara—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Someday, I want to follow in the glory... that Ramonu-san envisioned.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: "...I know. With who I am right now, I'm still lacking far too much to be saying things like that."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Still...!
choice_data_list: We'll make up for what's lacking together from now on.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
choice_data_list: I'm here to make you even stronger!
I'm here to make you even stronger!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: What do you mean, 'furthermore'...? Good grief.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
Seriously, you really are something...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Then, so I can take the Tiara route
in my Classic year, first let me enter
the Hanshin Juvenile Fillies.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Then, so I can take the Tiara route
in my Classic year, first let me enter
the Hanshin Juvenile Fillies.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
First, I'll make my mark in the prep race, the Hanshin JF...
and build up my strength for the real deal in the Tiara route!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"My goal is the Hanshin JF,
and then the Triple Tiara."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober has magnificently set forth
as a proud member of the noble Mejiro family...!
